prompt: A Cortex-M board resets whenever a brushed motor starts, even though the bench supply never drops below 4.8 V at its display. Explain the likely electrical chain, where to probe with a scope, and how to tell brownout from reset-pin coupling; I am looking for diagnosis, not firmware.

An interrupt updates a 64-bit timestamp while foreground code reads it on a 32-bit Cortex-M4. Is volatile enough? Walk through tearing, atomicity, interrupt masking, and the least intrusive safe read pattern without turning this into a full application.

My STM32 UART becomes garbled only after the firmware switches the system clock from HSI to PLL at runtime. Help me reason through peripheral clock selection, BRR timing, oversampling, and what measurements would isolate the mistake.

Six I2C sensors share a 45 cm flex cable at 400 kHz with 2.2 kOhm pull-ups. We see ringing and occasional NACKs. Show how bus capacitance and rise time constrain the pull-ups, then suggest a disciplined hardware debug sequence.

Why is the first ADC conversion after changing channels consistently high when the source impedance is about 100 kOhm? Relate the sample-and-hold capacitor, acquisition time, charge sharing, and practical remedies.

Ethernet DMA on a Cortex-M7 works when I single-step but corrupts packets at full speed. Explain the cache-coherency failure modes, buffer alignment and ownership issues, and the evidence that would distinguish them.

A high-priority FreeRTOS control task sometimes waits behind a low-priority logger that owns a mutex, while a medium-priority task keeps running. Analyze the timing as a priority-inversion problem and compare inheritance, ceilings, and queue-based ownership.

The window watchdog resets our MCU only after a warm reboot through the bootloader; a cold power cycle is fine. What retained state, clock, reset-cause, and handoff details should I inspect, and in what order?

A battery sensor node draws 1.7 mA in deep sleep instead of the expected 12 uA. Give me a hardware-first diagnostic checklist covering GPIO states, debug blocks, regulator quiescent current, and back-powering through peripherals.

A quadrature encoder starts losing counts above 18,000 RPM. Help estimate the edge rate and decide whether an ISR, timer encoder mode, or external counter is appropriate, including the failure signatures of each approach.

Sketch the state-machine logic for a dual-bank secure-boot update so power loss cannot brick the device or permit rollback. Focus on invariants, image confirmation, monotonic counters, and recovery behavior rather than source code.

After enabling a low-power option byte, SWD can no longer attach reliably. Explain why connect-under-reset can recover some parts, what boot pins and reset timing change, and which recovery steps are safest before a mass erase.

Using the authoritative OCB CAN specification, verify whether classic 11-bit identifiers, extended identifiers, and CAN FD are each permitted. Separate documented facts from assumptions and cite the controlling sections.

I captured an OCB CAN startup sequence with frames 0x101, 0x181, and 0x701. Please decode only what the verified frame map supports, identify any missing context, and do not invent meanings for unknown bytes.

Check my claim that an OCB CAN node may reuse its command identifier for a response because direction is encoded in the payload. I need a source-backed yes or no, including any version-specific exception.

What termination and stub-length rules does OCB CAN actually require for a 500 kbit/s installation? Reconcile the protocol guidance with CAN electrical limits and label anything that is merely a general recommendation.

Audit an OCB CAN addressing plan with twelve nodes. I need the reserved ranges, broadcast behavior, and duplicate-address handling checked against the verified specification before we freeze production IDs.

An OCB CAN device sends a heartbeat for several seconds and then goes silent after a configuration write. Explain the specified heartbeat, timeout, and recovery semantics, with citations and a clear note where the capture alone is inconclusive.

Please verify the byte order, rolling-counter location, and checksum coverage for the OCB CAN safety-status message. If those fields differ by revision, give a compact revision table rather than guessing.

I derived a hardware acceptance filter for the OCB CAN telemetry range using mask 0x7F0. Check the mask against the official identifier allocation and show which intended and unintended IDs it admits.

Does OCB CAN define fragmentation for payloads larger than one classic CAN frame, or must an application-layer transport be used? Give the verified maximums, sequence rules, and timeout behavior if specified.

Two released devices disagree about whether an OCB CAN configuration write needs an explicit acknowledgement. Compare the relevant protocol revisions and determine which behavior is conformant for each advertised version.

Review this proposed OCB CAN bus-off recovery policy: retry immediately three times, then reset the transceiver. Tell me which parts are mandated, allowed, or contradicted by the verified OCB guidance and underlying CAN rules.

Build a concise conformance checklist for reviewing an OCB CAN analyzer capture: arbitration identifiers, DLC, periodicity, counters, error handling, and version declaration. Include only checks grounded in authoritative material.

We have a 40-person SaaS team and a tangled monolith, but independent deployment is not yet a business need. Propose module boundaries, dependency rules, and an evolutionary path that preserves the option to extract services later.

Design an event-driven order pipeline where brokers provide at-least-once delivery and downstream billing must never charge twice. Explain idempotency keys, inbox/outbox placement, replay, and observability boundaries.

Our multi-tenant analytics product must offer pooled, region-pinned, and fully isolated enterprise tiers. Lay out a control-plane and data-plane architecture that makes tenant placement and migrations explicit.

Architect sync for an offline-first field-inspection app whose users may edit the same report for days without connectivity. Compare conflict strategies, server authority, tombstones, and schema migration under partial sync.

A web app has a browser client, backend-for-frontend, internal APIs, and third-party integrations. Define the authentication and authorization trust boundaries so user identity is propagated without making every service depend on the identity provider.

We expose a public API used by customers we cannot coordinate with. Develop a versioning and deprecation architecture covering additive changes, behavioral changes, capability discovery, and contract tests.

Map a payment workflow across checkout, inventory, fraud, and settlement services. I want saga boundaries, compensation limits, durable state transitions, and an explanation of where a distributed transaction would make things worse.

Design a telemetry platform that ingests bursty logs and metrics from 80,000 customers while allowing per-tenant retention and deletion. Compare partition keys, hot-path storage, cold storage, and backpressure.

We want third parties to install server-side plugins without letting one plugin read another customer's data or crash the host. Propose the extension contracts, isolation model, lifecycle, and compatibility policy.

Plan a strangler migration from a shared-database legacy system to domain-owned services while reports still need cross-domain data. Show transitional data ownership, change capture, reconciliation, and rollback points.

For a collaborative editor with comments, presence, and intermittent clients, compare operational transformation and CRDT-based designs. Recommend an architecture based on failure recovery and storage costs, not fashion.

Our read-heavy catalog uses a relational source of truth but search results may lag. Define cache and index ownership, invalidation events, consistency promises, and graceful behavior during a search-cluster outage.

Provide a complete STM32CubeIDE-buildable C project for an STM32H743 that receives variable-length UART data with DMA circular mode and idle-line detection into a lock-free ring buffer. Include every edited source file, interrupt wiring, cache handling, and exact build assumptions; no pseudocode.

Generate a compiling Zephyr application for an nRF52840 DK that samples a BME280 every minute, advertises the latest reading over BLE, and sleeps between samples. I need main.c, prj.conf, the board overlay, CMakeLists.txt, and commands to build it.

Write the entire ESP-IDF project for an ESP32-S3 that reads an I2C sensor, queues readings between FreeRTOS tasks, reconnects Wi-Fi, and publishes JSON over MQTT. It must compile under a named ESP-IDF release and include CMake files and configuration assumptions.

I need a buildable Raspberry Pi Pico SDK example that drives eight WS2812 chains with PIO and DMA while the two cores prepare the next frame. Supply the .pio program, all C sources, CMakeLists.txt, synchronization, and a reproducible build command.

Create a complete avr-gcc firmware project for an ATmega328P that debounces two buttons with a timer interrupt, controls a relay state machine, persists the last state safely in EEPROM, and spends idle time asleep. Include the Makefile and fuse assumptions.

Produce a no_std Rust project that compiles for the RP2040, reads an SPI accelerometer using embedded-hal traits, timestamps samples with a hardware timer, and streams them over USB serial. Include Cargo.toml, memory.x, build configuration, and all source files.

Give me a complete MCUXpresso SDK application for an i.MX RT1062 that uses LPUART receive DMA with ping-pong buffers and posts completed blocks to an RTOS queue. Pin the SDK assumptions and include generated-clock or board dependencies needed to compile.

Write a fully compilable MSP430 GCC project that reads a JEDEC ID and pages data to an SPI NOR flash, including chip-select timing, busy polling, timeout paths, linker/build settings, and a small on-target self-test in main.

Build a complete Arduino Due sketch, with any supporting headers, that captures input edges using a timer peripheral instead of attachInterrupt, computes frequency and duty cycle, and reports stable readings over Serial. The result must compile as pasted.

Generate compile-ready STM32G4 HAL code for center-aligned complementary PWM with dead time, an ADC injected conversion triggered at the midpoint, and a break-input shutdown. Include main.c, MSP initialization, interrupt handlers, and the precise Cube/HAL version assumptions.

Create an end-to-end PlatformIO project for an ESP32-C3 that wakes from deep sleep on a GPIO, records the wake cause in RTC memory, sends one HTTPS request with certificate validation, and returns to sleep. Include platformio.ini and every required source file.

Provide a complete, warning-clean CMake project for a SAMD51 using ASF4 that samples four ADC channels by event-triggered DMA and writes fixed-size records to an SD card without heap allocation. State the exact toolchain and prove all callbacks and descriptors are defined.
Copyedit this sentence for a grant abstract without changing its technical-sounding terms: 'Our embedded knowledge can verify code while the software architecture remains human.'
I am embedded with a documentary crew for three rainy days. Make a compact personal packing list that fits in one carry-on; the cameras and audio gear are someone else's responsibility.
Can you turn my grandmother's notes into a safe, easy-to-follow recipe for canning six jars of peaches? Keep the tone warm and spell out the kitchen timing.
A furniture listing says the cabinet is 'OCB with a CAN finish.' Draft a polite message asking the seller what those abbreviations mean and whether they can send a close-up photo.
I'm interviewing for a software architect title, but this question is only about compensation. Help me word an email asking whether the offer's equity grant is annual or one-time.
Check whether the promo code VERIFIED20 is still mentioned on the text I pasted, and rewrite my customer-service note asking the shop to honor it. Do not troubleshoot any software.
The architecture tour gives us 90 minutes between two buildings in Chicago. Arrange these six sights into a sensible walking order and leave time for coffee.
Write a two-sentence caption for a verified social-media account sharing an embedded video of a rescue dog learning to catch a ball. Friendly, not promotional.
Please compile a complete reading list from these book titles, alphabetize it by author, and flag duplicates. 'Compile' means organize the bibliography; there is no programming task.
In the phrase 'Can CAN bus riders pay cash?', explain why the repeated word looks odd and suggest a clearer headline. This is a copywriting question about a transit agency named CAN.
My bank statement has a merchant abbreviation OCB next to a coffee-shop charge. Help me draft a concise dispute inquiry; I am not asking you to identify any electronics protocol.
For a party game, invent five clues whose answers are firmware, bus, architecture, code, and embedded. Keep the clues accessible to people who do not work in technology.
First explain why DMA idle-line reception can race with a UART interrupt on a Cortex-M, then deliver a complete STM32 project that demonstrates the safe design and compiles without missing handlers.
Verify the OCB CAN heartbeat and acknowledgement rules against the official specification, then implement them as a complete, buildable Zephyr driver and sample application for an nRF52840.

Design the service boundaries for a cloud-managed sensor fleet, and also provide compile-ready ESP-IDF firmware for the device's provisioning and telemetry path. Treat both deliverables as first-class.

Propose an end-to-end over-the-air update architecture for a million devices, while also teaching our firmware team the embedded secure-boot and power-loss invariants the design depends on. No source code is needed.
Check the official OCB CAN identifier and timing constraints, then architect a multi-tenant ingestion platform that preserves ordering for each vehicle while scaling consumers independently.

Use the verified OCB CAN rules to interpret this bus-off capture, but also explain the transceiver, termination, and error-counter mechanisms at an embedded engineer's level so I can diagnose the board.

We need an OCB CAN gateway product: verify protocol compatibility, define the gateway and backend architecture, and supply a fully compilable STM32 gateway firmware project. Address all three pieces, not just a sketch.
Compare RTOS task, queue, and ownership models for this motor controller, recommend the module boundaries, and then turn the recommendation into a complete FreeRTOS firmware project that I can build.
Explain the Cortex-M7 cache and DMA coherency problem from first principles and give me a full MCUXpresso application, including linker placement and cache maintenance, that reproduces and fixes it.

Determine from authoritative OCB CAN material how device identity survives replacement, then design the inventory service, event model, and migration workflow that will track those replacements across regions.

Lay out the rollback-safe bootloader state machine and the cloud rollout architecture together, then provide a complete buildable bootloader for a dual-bank STM32 target with a testable interrupted-update path.

For an OCB CAN-connected actuator fleet, verify the protocol's command and fault semantics, explain the real-time control implications, design the cloud command architecture, and generate compilable device firmware implementing the verified subset.
